recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片（B）幾乎全為核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質深藍且帶空泡的原紅血球（proerythroblast）樣細胞；切片（C）呈高度細胞密集的片狀浸潤，CD71（D）與 E-cadherin（E）膜染色陽性證實為紅血球系，符合急性紅血球白血病（pure erythroid leukemia）。
features: Panel A: peripheral blood with rare atypical blasts showing deeply basophilic cytoplasm, one large with a blue cytoplasmic rim
Panel B: hypercellular aspirate dominated by immature erythroid precursors with round nuclei, fine chromatin, nucleoli and intensely basophilic, occasionally vacuolated cytoplasm
Panel B: few maturing normoblasts and scant granulocytic elements
Panel C: hypercellular core biopsy with sheets of immature cells and scattered hemoglobinized erythroid cells
Panels D-E: many cells with membranous CD71 and E-cadherin positivity, confirming erythroid lineage
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows rare circulating blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate is markedly cellular and dominated by immature erythroid precursors, many proerythroblast-like, with round nuclei, fine chromatin, nucleoli and intensely basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm, accompanied by few maturing normoblasts and reduced granulopoiesis. The core biopsy is hypercellular with sheets of immature cells that express CD71 and E-cadherin by immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia; in a child, NUP98 rearrangement testing is warranted.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythroid hyperplasia shows full maturation with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and hypersegmented neutrophils, whereas AEL has a predominance (at least 30%) of proerythroblasts and corrects neither with B12 nor folate.
Megakaryoblasts can also have basophilic blebbed cytoplasm but are CD41/CD61 positive and CD71/E-cadherin negative.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19 giant pronormoblasts / erythroid recovery
ddx.vs: Parvovirus shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions amid erythroid aplasia rather than sheets of proerythroblasts.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumors in children are CD71/E-cadherin negative and form cohesive clusters with lineage-specific markers.
